findings.title: Full any/any/any permit
findings.where: security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy allow-any
findings.recommendation: Restrict source, destination and application to the strict minimum (least privilege). A permit any/any/any defeats the point of filtering.
fix: # review then replace — example tightening:
# delete security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy allow-any
# set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy allow-any match source-address <SRC_OBJECT>
# set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy allow-any match destination-address <DST_OBJECT>
# set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy allow-any match application <APP>

findings.title: Default SNMP community: 'public'
findings.recommendation: Remove the public/private communities, prefer SNMPv3.
fix: delete snmp community public

findings.title: SSH root-login allowed
findings.recommendation: Forbid direct root login via SSH.
fix: set system services ssh root-login deny

findings.title: SSH protocol v1 allowed
fix: set system services ssh protocol-version v2

findings.title: Telnet enabled
fix: delete system services telnet

findings.title: Web-management over HTTP (unencrypted)
findings.recommendation: Disable HTTP, only expose HTTPS for J-Web.
fix: delete system services web-management http

findings.title: host-inbound-traffic system-services = all
findings.recommendation: Only allow the management services strictly necessary inbound on the zone (never 'all', especially on an external zone). Exposing 'all' publishes every service of the engine.
fix: delete security zones security-zone trust host-inbound-traffic system-services all
# then add only what's needed, e.g.:
# set security zones security-zone trust host-inbound-traffic system-services ping

findings.title: Management service(s) exposed externally: ssh
findings.recommendation: Don't expose SSH/HTTP/HTTPS/NETCONF/Telnet inbound from an external zone. Manage via a dedicated administration network / VPN.
fix: # delete security zones security-zone untrust host-inbound-traffic system-services <ssh>

findings.title: External zone with no screen (ids-option)
findings.recommendation: Attach a screen to this zone: SYN-flood, ip-spoofing, scan, land, teardrop protection… Recommended baseline.
fix: # baseline screen (to adjust):
set security screen ids-option untrust-screen icmp flood threshold 1000
set security screen ids-option untrust-screen ip spoofing
set security screen ids-option untrust-screen tcp syn-flood alarm-threshold 1024
set security screen ids-option untrust-screen tcp syn-flood attack-threshold 2000
set security screen ids-option untrust-screen tcp land
set security zones security-zone untrust screen untrust-screen

findings.title: Deny/reject with no logging
findings.where: security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy deny-all
findings.recommendation: Enable 'log session-init' on denies to detect rejected access attempts.
fix: set security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy deny-all then log session-init

findings.title: Permit with no logging
findings.where: security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy allow-any
fix: set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy allow-any then log session-close

findings.title: SNMP v1/v2c in use, no v3
NTP not configured
findings.recommendation: Synchronize the clock (essential for log timestamping).
fix: # set system ntp server <NTP_IP>
